seed: Objects of type `marker` under action ACTION6 with touching neighbours [hazard,hit,wall] show mixed outcomes: gone x1, x,y x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the presence, type or relative position of a neighbouring object. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Unarmed blocks move four cells with mirrored horizontal directions.
Inactive-marker clicks arm/select; active-marker clicks are no-ops; armed-block clicks disarm.
Only the selected marker moves while armed; its full destination cell must be floor colour 5.
HUD rounds 64*actions/150 and uses exact-frame continuity with a stateless phase fallback.
All 63 observed transitions pass; action 7 and ambiguous disconnected HUD phases remain unconfirmed.
